description: This file is a PHP script that generates an HTML page for editing a managed service to be blocked within a parental control system. It includes server-side logic to retrieve service details, client-side JavaScript for form handling, validation, and AJAX submission, and HTML form elements for user input.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the form with existing service data, sets up event handlers for form controls, validation rules, and AJAX submission.

methods.name: updateBlockTimeVisibility
methods.description: Enables or disables the time selection inputs based on whether the service is set to always block or not.
